tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

args.summary: After the latest deploy, checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. (Its staging candidate v2.3.1-rc was also marked unhealthy.) The service was rolled back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, all regions are on v2.3.0, the service reports healthy, and the error rate is ~0.2%. Next steps: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, it's healthy again, and the SEV2 incident is open.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of about 18%. v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production, so I rolled back to that. All regions are now on v2.3.0, the service reports healthy and the error rate has dropped to about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api) is open and the on-call engineer has been paged. It describes the failure, the rollback and the recovery. It also asks for the root cause to be found before v2.3.1 is deployed again; its staging version had also been marked unhealthy.
- **Duplicate check:** my first attempt to open the incident timed out. I checked the incident list, saw it hadn't been created, and tried again with the same idempotency key so it couldn't be opened twice. There's only one incident.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
